source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 156 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 156 was established by Ordinance No. 18004, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 12, 1983. Ordinance No. 18004 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 156 is established on property generally located between Churchill Way and Willow Lane, east of the east line of Preston Road. The size of PD 156 is approximately 9.2186 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-156.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development must be in accordance with the lot arrangement and street location shown on the city council-approved development plan, which is labelled Exhibit 156A. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.105.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the county clerk of the county in which the property is located. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.106.USES. Development is limited to detached dwelling units for single-family uses only. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.107.DENSITY. Development is limited to a maximum of 33 dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.108.HEIGHT. Maximum permitted height for all buildings and structures is 24 feet. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.109.COVERAGE. Maximum permitted site coverage for each lot is 50 percent. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.110.SETBACKS. Minimum setbacks for all buildings and structures are those shown on the approved development plan. These setbacks must be shown on every subdivision plat or replat of all or any portion of this property. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.111.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51-7.400. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: Pedestrian Easement Barrier
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.112.PEDESTRIAN EASEMENT BARRIER. The pedestrian easement connecting the two cul-de-sacs must be barricaded to prohibit vehicular traffic. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.113.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development of this property must comply with all codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-156.114.PAVING.
(a)All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must comply with the requirements of Division 51-4.300, “Off-street Parking and Loading Regulations.”
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.115.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there is full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-156.116.ZONING MAP. PD 156 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. Nos. 18004; 25508)
